subject: Residential and Square Zoning Amendments
overview: The board held a comprehensive public hearing to collect testimony on proposed residential, square, and accessory dwelling unit zoning updates, featuring input from the Mayor and the DPW Commissioner. All related public hearings were continued to August 6th for board deliberation.

items.title: Procedural Matters
items.summary: The chair called the meeting to order, performed a roll call, and introduced planning department staff.

items.title: Agenda Postponement
items.summary: The board postponed the scheduled executive session due to technical difficulties with the remote meeting platform.

items.title: Public Works Infrastructure Testimony
items.summary: DPW Commissioner Tim McGivern answered board questions regarding the capacity of water, sewer, and roadway infrastructure to support increased residential density.

items.title: Mayor's Comments
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn urged the board to slow down the zoning overhaul process, citing significant infrastructure backlogs and school overcrowding.

items.title: Public Comment on Proposed Zoning
items.summary: Dozens of residents provided testimony for and against the proposed neighborhood residential districts, Accessory Dwelling Units (ADUs), and West Medford Square districts.

items.title: Continuation of Public Hearings
items.summary: Referred the neighborhood residential, ADU, and square zoning hearings to August 6th for board deliberation and direction to the consultant.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes for the June 18th and June 25th meetings.

items.title: Staff Zoning Updates and Adjournment
items.summary: The Director of Planning updated the board on upcoming City Council referrals and a new development project near Wellington before adjourning the meeting.
